convertibility_reason: Uses only two built-in iMA indicators with simple crossover logic, fixed SL/TP in pips, fixed lot sizing, and no external dependencies. All logic is straightforward and maps directly to Python/standard libraries.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (implicit in no_position gate with reversal entry)

custom_logic_notes: EA uses IsNewBar pattern to evaluate crossover only once per completed bar, comparing bar index [1] and [2] (previous and prior bars) to confirm crossover has occurred on the just-closed bar. SL and TP input values are in pips and are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to convert to points for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward dual SMA crossover system. Use pandas rolling mean for both MAs. Signal detection: fast_ma[1] crosses above/below slow_ma[1] using [1] and [2] indices (previous bar crossover confirmed on bar close). SL/TP in pips need digit-adjustment: if price has 5 decimal places, multiply pip values by 10 to get points. No external indicator libraries needed. Position check ensures only one position at a time.
